document.about: ICML 2021 (PMLR v139), Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision. Page 8 sets two columns of text under a full-width figure whose ruled table and labels run across the gutter, with the figure's caption across both columns.

checks.issue: #436: no gutter runs through the figure, so the columns under it were read line by line across the gutter.
checks.text: We conducted de-duplication analysis to investigate this with full details in the supplementary material.

checks.issue: #436: the right column's lines alternated with the left column's.
checks.text: Additionally, given that CLIP does not need task-specific training data, it can unlock certain niche tasks with greater ease.
